simple.meaning: הֶבֶל (hebel) is a Hebrew object word meaning “emptiness or vanity ; figuratively, something transitory and unsatisfactory ; often used as an adverb.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Deuteronomy 32:21. The surrounding context includes family, family line, covenant, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הֶבֶל (H1892) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
